efn:zansetsu.name: 『Blade Mode』
efn:zansetsu.tooltip:
The mountains don't give back what they take...

◆ Activation Condition
 When holding 'HF-Murasama', hold [%s] to consume skill charge and enter 【Blade Mode】

◆ Mode Mechanics
 Duration: %.1f seconds × HF-Murasama's current weapon charge stacks
 Basic Operation: Move mouse left/right to switch slash direction
  · Click Left Button - Execute a single slash
  · Hold Left Button - Execute a reciprocating slash
 Advanced Operation: Hold [%s] to switch input mode
  In this mode, swipe mouse in 8 directions to directly execute slashes

◆ Finisher
 When slashes hit a certain number of times or target's health falls below a certain percentage
 Press RMB to execute 【Zandatsu】

※ This skill is exclusive to 'HF-Murasama', other weapons cannot use it

If the level is below 0, no spell is cast

efs_iss:mana_shield.tooltip: When taking damage, consumes mana proportional to the ratio of damage value to max HP to offset the damage

epicfight:adrenaline_fiend.name: Adrenaline Fiend
epicfight:adrenaline_fiend.tooltip: Starts to regenerate stamina immediately when killing a mob.

epicfight:battojutsu.name: Battojutsu

epicfight:bonebreaker.tooltip: Gain a damage bonus against an enemy you've recently attacked by %s%%. Stacks up to %d and the stack will be reset if you strike another target.

epicfight:catharsis.name: Catharsis
epicfight:catharsis.tooltip: Charges your weapon when dodging attacks.

epicfight:combat_mastery_i.name: Combat Mastery I
epicfight:combat_mastery_i.tooltip: You have grown more adept at seizing opportunities between offense and evasion. You can dodge while attacking, or follow up with an attack after dodging.

epicfight:combat_mastery_ii.name: Combat Mastery II
epicfight:combat_mastery_ii.tooltip: For a short time after dodging, sprinting will enter the [Dash] state. While in [Dash], stamina will be continuously consumed.

epicfight:dancing_edge.name: Dancing Edge
epicfight:dancing_edge.tooltip: Cut down enemies with a lethal flourish! It strikes 3 times

epicfight:death_harvest.name: Death Harvest
epicfight:death_harvest.tooltip: Regain weapon charge when killing an enemy with an innate weapon skill.

epicfight:demolition_leap.name: Demolition Leap
epicfight:demolition_leap.tooltip: Gather energy to launch yourself into a targeted direction, reducing next fall damage by 50%.

epicfight:emergency_escape.name: Emergency Escape
epicfight:emergency_escape.tooltip:
Allows a player dodging when being hit or out of stamina.

Allows a player canceling attack motions and dodge. (Always activated)

epicfight:endurance.name: Endurance
epicfight:endurance.tooltip: Grants stun resistance as an amount of stamina consumed for %s seconds if a player is hit while preparing an attack.

epicfight:everlasting_allegiance.name: Everlasting Allegiance
epicfight:everlasting_allegiance.tooltip: Recall your thrown trident, damaging all enemies in it's path.

epicfight:eviscerate.name: Eviscerate
epicfight:eviscerate.tooltip: Tear into the enemy with a savage stab. Successfully hitting an enemy will rip out the dagger, dealing critical damage.

epicfight:forbidden_strength.name: Forbidden Strength
epicfight:forbidden_strength.tooltip: Consumes health instead of stamina when it's insufficient.

epicfight:grasping_spire.name: Grasping Spire

epicfight:guard.name: Guard
epicfight:guard.tooltip: Right-click to guard against frontal attacks. Continued guarding will consume more stamina.

epicfight:hypervitality.name: Hyper Vitality
epicfight:hypervitality.tooltip: Uses stamina instead of weapon charge when it's not full.

epicfight:impact_guard.name: Impact Guard
epicfight:impact_guard.tooltip: Reduces stamina consumption and guard penalty on guarding. You can guard against explosions, fire, magic, and projectiles, taking %d%% of the original damage.

epicfight:katana_skill.name: Stance Flow
epicfight:katana_skill.tooltip:
§8Attacks build stance stacks. Sweeping Edge increases the cap. Current weapon cap: §e%s§8.

§8Idle Cast: Swap between §c[Unsheathed]§8 and §b[Sheathed]§8 stances for free.
§8Attack Cast: §e[Flow]§8, granting invincibility frames.

§c[Unsheathed Skill]§8: Consumes all stacks to deal multiplied damage based on the number of stacks.
§b[Sheathed Skill]§8: Consumes all stacks to unleash (stacks - 1) extra dimensional slashes

epicfight:liechtenauer.name: Liechtenauer
epicfight:liechtenauer.tooltip: Assume a defensive stance for %s seconds. Player can deflect all attacks from in front while attacking. Killing enemies increases defensive stance duration by %s seconds. You cannot sprint while this effect is active.

epicfight:meteor_slam.name: Meteor Slam
epicfight:meteor_slam.tooltip:
§oApocalypse descended from the sky.§r

Crash into the ground with a powerful slam. Height increases damage done and stamina consumed. Take damage if fall damage exceeds stamina limit.

epicfight:parrying.name: Parrying
epicfight:parrying.tooltip: Allows a player to time guards accordingly to prevent stamina use. Player is able to guard against ranged attacks.

epicfight:phantom_ascent.name: Phantom Ascent
epicfight:phantom_ascent.tooltip: Allows a player to jump %d times more in the air.

epicfight:relentless_combo.name: Relentless Combo
epicfight:relentless_combo.tooltip: Release a devastating flurry of blows!

epicfight:revelation.name: Revelation

§oEye of Hawk catching the weakpoints of the enemies§r

epicfight:roll.name: Roll
epicfight:roll.tooltip: Roll in the direction a player is moving. Evades all incoming attacks.

epicfight:rushing_tempo.name: Rushing Tempo

§8Attempt to grab a target in front of you. Upon success, you may follow up with:
  §6Decapitate §a[Left Click]§8: Deals (3 × Weapon Damage + Target's Max HP) as damage.
  §6Hymn of the Night §a[Right Click]§8: Slams the target down, dealing (8 × Weapon Damage × 0.1) Dark Magic damage and healing for the same amount.
§8If the grab fails, a powerful slash is performed instead.

epicfight:sharp_stab.name: Sharp Stab

epicfight:stamina_pillager.name: Stamina Pillager
epicfight:stamina_pillager.tooltip: Regain %s%% of missing stamina when killing your target.

epicfight:sweeping_edge.name: Sweeping Edge

falchionmoveset:falchion_art.name: Faith and Virtue
falchionmoveset:falchion_art.tooltip:
Slice enemies in a wide area. There will be three different attacks depending on the direction you type. 
Fearless: The third normal attack will not be interrupted by the enemy's attack. 
Forward: Perform two quick upward slashes to the front, which can effectively knockback the enemy. 
Left/Right: Fast diagonal slash that cannot be interrupted by enemy attacks. 
Backward: After sweeping across a wide area, perform a slash on the enemy that knocks them down. Can use air slash to perform additional attacks on downed enemies

wom:agony_plunge.tooltip:
"Disappear in the sky before diving on your enemies."

 Attacking enemies will charge this for up to 3 times.

wom:all_eyes_on_me.tooltip:
dealing damage with 8 different attack will trigger "look - at - me".

 look - at - me :
  Regenerate your health, stamina and innate power moderably over 4 sec however, performing action during that time will cancel that effect.

wom:all_eyes_on_you.name: All Eyes on You
wom:all_eyes_on_you.tooltip:

 And watch over you :
  Regenerate your stamina and innate power slowly over 8 sec.

wom:aqua_maneuvre.tooltip:
Improve swiming ability.

 Swim faster under water or a little less faster above water.

 Release jump button to propel under water or butterfly swim above water.

wom:arrow_tenacity.name: Arrow tenacity
wom:arrow_tenacity.tooltip: Prevent the stun from arrows damage. This skill is permanent, thus you can use another passive on top of it but, you'll only keep the current passive if you die.

wom:avatar_of_might.tooltip: Holding sneak for 2 sec will release a chockwave that pushes enemy away and grant you with Stun immunity for a short period.

wom:back_and_forth.name: Back and ... FORTH !
wom:back_and_forth.tooltip:
Allow you to blackout your target after reaching a certain distance from it.

Attack your target once then move away from it.
Once the distance beetween you and your target is greater than 20,your next dash attack will be a strong stun that blackout your target for 5sec.

wom:bull_charge.name: Ravanger force
wom:bull_charge.tooltip:
Charge forward pushing away any entity that come across your path.

You are immune to stun effect during the charge and take 40% less damage

wom:buster_parade.name: Dread full buster
wom:buster_parade.tooltip:
Windup your weapon for 1 to 2s, then, release a powerfull attack that bypass guard and cause blackout if the target was blocking or attacking.

 Available Weapon Types : %s

wom:charybdis.tooltip: Consume Stamina to perform a whirlwind of hit for a total of 8 strikes. Reduce the stamina consumption with sweeping edge.

wom:counter_attack.tooltip:
Perfect Guard will trigger a counter attack based on weapons attacks.

Available Weapon Types : %s

wom:critical_knowledge.tooltip:
Give you %s%% chance to deal %s%% more damage.

Critical chance is increased with Fire protection.

Critical damage is increased with Blast protection

wom:dancing_blade.name: Dancing blade
wom:dancing_blade.tooltip:
"Dance on the sound of death"

Gain 80% damage on every 4th successfull attack.

wom:demonic_ascension.name: Demonic Ascension
wom:demonic_ascension.tooltip:
"The scythe takes possession of your body
 and use it to perform terrible things...."

Ascenscion :
 on a large area, try to Apply Wither effect
 before applying 50% catharsis* on affected entity.

In Demon form:
 Base Duration is equal to 20s x (1 + (Sweeping edge level) / 3).
 Dash attack have twice the chance to apply wither effect but
 will consume more and more health if used multiple times.
 Other attacks will cause 80% Catharsis* on withered entitys if they hit.

 *Catharsis: Reap of the wither effect from the target
 dealing the remaining damage depending on the catharsis percentage at once
 and heal you for the remaining of that percentage.
 catharsis also increase the Demon form
 duration depending on their wither state
 (+3s for wither II and +6s for wither III).

wom:dodge_master.name: Dodge master
wom:dodge_master.tooltip:
Instinctly dodge a small distance if you would take damage after the cast within a window of 0.30s. Continuesly dodge all attack after the first one within a window of 0.50s and after each succesful dodge.

Double stamina consumption on multiple cast.

wom:dopamine.name: Dopamine
wom:dopamine.tooltip:
Convert the damage dealt with a dash attack into stamina.

 Afterward, get in cooldown for 4sec.

wom:ender_blast.name: Ender blast
wom:ender_blast.tooltip:
"The zenith of the End world technological power."

The blaster loader is composed of 12 chambers.
Kinetic energy is stored in them and transmuted into endpower.
When the trigger is pressed, half of the converted endpower
is condensed into end bullets.
The other half is transfered into a particle accelerator that overcharges
the endpower until it blasts the bullet out with tremendous force and precision.
All of that in just a fraction of a second ... outstanding!

wom:ender_fusion.name: Ender fusion
wom:ender_fusion.tooltip:
"The zenith of the End world technological power."

Two blaster loader with 12 chambers each for 24 in Total.
the Kinetic energy stored is shared between both Blasters
and transmuted into endpower for each.
When the trigger is pressed, half of the converted endpower
is condensed into end bullets.
The other half is transfered into a particle accelerator that overcharges
the endpower until it blasts the bullet out with tremendous force and precision.
All of that in just a fraction of a second ... outstanding!

wom:ender_obscuris.name: Ender obscuris
wom:ender_obscuris.tooltip:
Teleport you behind the last hitted target within 30 blocks (in radius from your position).

While executing this skill, player become immune from physical attacks.

wom:ender_step.name: Ender step
wom:ender_step.tooltip: A fast teleportion away from the danger. While executing this skill, player become immune from physical attacks.

wom:flash_mutilation.name: Flash mutilation
wom:flash_mutilation.tooltip: Teleport yourself around a target before performing a spin attack.

wom:heart_shield.tooltip:
Give you 20 shield point that will recover if no action is performed for %ssec at the rate of 1 point every %ssec.

Shield recovery rate can be improved with Protection enchantment.

wom:inner_growth.tooltip:

wom:latent_retribution.tooltip:

 Retribution :
  For 4 sec, gives stun immunity and increase your attack by 40%.

wom:lethal_focus.name: Lethal Focus
wom:lethal_focus.tooltip:
Each instance of damage will increase your damage by %s%% until it reaches %s%%.
 If no action is performed within 2sec, the damage will decrease rapidly.

Damage addup is increased with Fire protection.

Damage max is increased with blast protection lvl.

wom:lunar_eclipse.name: Lunar Eclipse
wom:lunar_eclipse.tooltip:
"Moonlight shadowing the night"

 Strike foes in front of you
 and makes them glow for 7sec.

 In Recto : 
  - Attaking Glowing targets, stack your damage
    and increase their Glowing lvl.
  - Attaking Blind targets, stack your damage
    and remove their Blindness.

 In Verso: 
  - Attaking Glowing targets, stack your damage
    and remove their Glowing.
  - Attaking Blind targets, increase their Blindness lvl

 Recto Jump attack ( Crescent )
  Unleash all stacked damage on the target.
  If it kills the target, it bounce to the closest target
  and loose 5% of its damage.
    Glowing increase the bounce range.
    Blindness increase the damage.

 Verso Jump attack ( Fullmoon )
  Unleash 70% of the stacked damage in Aoe.
    Blindness increase the damage.

wom:lunatic_vivacity.name: Lunatic Vivacity
wom:lunatic_vivacity.tooltip:
Cycle between 2 phase while facing a target.

 [Lunatic Rush] Decrease your stamina consumption by 85%.
 Not facing target will stop the timer but not grant any stamina reduction.

 [Lunatic Linger] Increase your stamina consumption by 85%.
 Facing a target will double the speed of the timer.

wom:manipulator.name: Manipulator
wom:manipulator.tooltip:
Blocking an attack will grant you stamina based on the timming of the block and your missing stamina.

 Perfect block = 60% missing stamina 

 Regular block = 0~30% missing stamina

wom:meditation.name: Meditation
wom:meditation.tooltip:
Sneak for 2 second without moving to enter in state of meditation. the longer you meditate the longer the buff.
There is 3 stage of meditation each giving different effect:

 Stage 1: 40% damage dealing.

 Stage 2: 30% attack speed and Movement speed I

 Stage 3: 50% damage reduction and Regeneration I

wom:mindset.name: Mindset
wom:mindset.tooltip:
While above 80% Health,
gain mindest which will increase your damage by 30% and decrease the damage recieved by 20%

wom:natural_sprinter.name: Natural Sprinter
wom:natural_sprinter.tooltip:
Improve running ability.

 While [HOLDING] your sprint key for 1 sec,
 burst into a faster sprinting motion.

 Releasing sprint button will perform a [Burst step]:
 -  Short Boost forward at the cost of stamina.

 Jumping while spritting will lunch you further and slightly higher.
 Sneaking while sprinting will allow you to slide into 1 block gap.

wom:orbital_beam.name: Orbital beam
wom:orbital_beam.tooltip: Call an orbital beam that strike foes in your gaze.

wom:pain_anticipation.name: Pain anticipation
wom:pain_anticipation.tooltip:
If no action is performed within 2 sec, your next action will trigger "Anticipation".
 Anticipation :
  For 2 sec, gives stun immunity and decrease damage recieved by 40%.

wom:perfect_bulwark.tooltip:
Holding Guard stance will block attacks from all directions at low progressive stamina cost.
Releasing guard after being hit 5 times will send a shockwave that pushes enemys away. 

Available Weapon Types : %s

wom:plunder_perdition.name: Ender Ritual
wom:plunder_perdition.tooltip:
"Own the ancient arcane of the endermen."

 When triggering this skill, you can choose
 between 4 different type of actions:
  - in neutral and rather close to target, you'll do an [Ender Assault]
    while alternating between left swing and right swing. 
  - While sprinting, you will do an [Ender Assault] and,
    if the attack connect, trigger positive [Ender Snatch].
  - While rising in the air, you will trigger aerian
    [Ender Assault] and, trigger negative [Ender Snatch].
  - While sneaking and with 10 stored stack,
    you'll summon Ender Hands under targets around you.
   Then the hands grasps their respective targets,
    Damagind them and inflicting them with mining fatigue and slowness.

 [Ender Assault] - Teleport you around your target depending
 on the direction you are look at.

 [Ender Snatch] -

wom:precise_roll.name: Precise roll
wom:precise_roll.tooltip:
Faster, further and cheaper roll.

 Perform acrobatic Roll like a true expert.

wom:proximity_exploiter.name: Proximity Exploiter
wom:proximity_exploiter.tooltip: For each living things within 5 blocks of you, regenerate 3 innate power every 0.5s sec.

wom:punishment_kick.name: Punishment kick
wom:punishment_kick.tooltip: Kick in front of you with force. Cause strong Stun and can blackout if perform during enemy attack.

wom:rechargement.name: Rechargement
wom:rechargement.tooltip:
"Il n'y a que deux puissances au monde, le sabre et l'esprit : à la longue, le sabre est toujours vaincu par l'esprit."

 After attacking performing skill will reload ammunition
 depending on the attack made before it.

  - 1 ammo after first attack.
  - 2 ammo after the second attacks.
  - 3 ammo afer the third one.

 The last attack of the normal combo will also realod 3 ammo.

 To shoot your ammo, you must perform an attack or a reload first.
 You can also shoot right after sprinting or if you are rising in the air (jumping).

 Dealing damage with a shot will increase [Heatdrive] depending on the bullet type.
 [Heatdrive] slowly decrease if no shot damage is dealt within 4 sec.
 When fully charged, [Heatdrive] become [Souldrive]:
  during that state, the drive will quickly decrease but,
  every second during that state will reload 1 ammo.

 Ammo can be overcharged if rechargement is performed when 6 ammo is allready loaded.
 Overcharged Ammo deal more damage and bypass guards.

 Reloading to reach exactly 6 ammo or 6 overcharged ammo will double
 the reload ammount for as long as you keep your reloads to reach exactly 6.

wom:regierung.name: Regierung
wom:regierung.tooltip:
"Unbreakable defense combined with overwhelming offense rules over battle."

 On cast, you'll perform shield attacks in front of you.
 There is 3 Basic attacks, 1 Dash attack and
 1 Jump attack for both the sword and the shield.

 Some attacks (shields or sword attacks) will move your in front of you.
 While this occure, the shield will have a slight red field around it as an indicator.
 During this short period,you will block incoming attacks and
 perform an automatic counter attack.

 Depending on how you block an attack, you will increase you Shield Charges by a certain amount.
 (increased with sweeping edge lvl)
 Shield Charges can be stored for up to 90 and used in 2 ways:
  - With the Shield, by holding guard and casting a shield attack.
    You will convert all Shield charge into shield Overcharge,
    granting you damage resistance.
  - With the Sword, by holding guard and casting a sword attack.
    You will charge your sword and consume your
     shield charges slowly to perform a spin attack.

 While your shield is Overcharged, your shield attack will do
 increase damage after a sword attack based on the Overcharge amount.

 Getting damaged reduce your Shield Overcharge by 5.
 ( Sweeping edge on your Sword reduce this by 1 per level )

wom:sakura_state.name: Sakura state
wom:sakura_state.tooltip:
"Sharpest blade forged in absolute serenity"

 On cast, you'll perform a Sakura slash.
 Sakura slashes can be declined in 2 form
  - while sprinting,
  you will fastly pass through enemys in front of you, slashing them along the way.  - while sprinting, (cost 2 stack)
  you will fastly pass through enemys in front of you,
  slashing them along the way.
  - while standing or walking, (cost 1 stack)
  you'll fastly slash in front of you.
 Sakura slashes automaticaly sheath your blade afterward.

 You can stack a total of 12 sakura slashes and Sweeping edge
 on your blade will grant you extra stack depending
 on the amount of stack you have on the first cast.
([initial amont of stack] * 1/3 of the sweeping edge levels)

 After the innitial draw, you'll enter sakura state.
 If you don't draw a Sakura slash again within 4 seconds, you loose all your
 stacks and get out of sakura state.

 Slashing a target with a Dash attack or a Sakura slash,
 will stack Perpetual slashes on the target.
 (3 on dashes and sakura slash.
 6 on sakura dash slash
 this value is then multiply by 1/3 of the Sweeping edge lvl).
 If no action is performed for a set of time after landing perpetual slashes,
 All Perpetual slashes stacked on the target are triggered,
 slashing it in sequence for each stacks of Perpetual slashes

wom:shadow_step.name: Shadow step
wom:shadow_step.tooltip:
§oSink in the shadows.§r
Moving in the shadow will twist space to make you move faster than the light itself.

While executing this skill, player become immune from physical attacks.

wom:shooting_style.name: Shooting Style
wom:shooting_style.tooltip:
When empty handed, holding sneak while attacking will do kicks.

 The combo contain 3 different kick.

wom:shulker_cloak.name: Shulker cloak
wom:shulker_cloak.tooltip:
Loose the ability to guard.

 Every 5 sec, You gain one level of shulker resistance. 

If you have at least 1 level of Shulker resistance, you will negate 60% of damage.

Getting damaged reduce the level by 1.

wom:solar_arcano.name: Solar Arcano
wom:solar_arcano.tooltip:
"Witness the full force of a star"

 After each basic attack, a special icon will apear within a short period.
 Press the Skill button when you see it to perform a timed Solar attack.
 Solar attack cycle between ignites ( Polvora ) and explode ( Chispear ):

    Polvora : set the target in fire. if target is
    allready in fire, increase ignitions level by 1.
    (can only go up to 2)

    Chispear: if target is in fire, extinguish the fire and
    explode for a set of damage depending on the ignitions level.
    (3 => 6 => 9, +1 per sweeping edge lvl)

 Solar have a unique skill meter mechanique.
 Heat level, wich is showed by the percentage number on the skill,
 can change color (from red to white) depending on the Heating speed.
 Increase Heat level by increasing heating speed above
 the orange lvl by successfully performing Chispear.
 The heating speed increase depends on the target ignition level.

 Hold guard and press skill to perform Solar Brasero.
 Solar Brasero harvest heat level to perform incendiary spell:

    Obscuridad: Infuse your blade with soul fire,
    melting it into a new form.
    All attacks within this form trigger Chispear.
    Lock your heating speed to red.

    Crematorio: breath soul fire in front of you.
    Burns targets to ignitions level 3.
    Durations depends on the amount of time
    they stay in the flame.

    Infierno: Burn target around you in a spherical shape.
    The area of effect will keep growing until 10 sec.
    Every 2sec, target within the area are affected by polvora.
    (can increase ignition level to 3)
    During infierno, all the speed at wich heat level is affected is doubled.

wom:soul_protection.name: Soul protection
wom:soul_protection.tooltip:
Loose the ability to guard.

 Each second you summon a soul that give 1% damage negation.
Your own soul give you 20% damage negation.

 Getting damaged will remove 3 souls.

wom:spider_techniques.name: Spider techniques
wom:spider_techniques.tooltip:
Allow you to run on walls.

 Hold sprint and jump toward a wall to run on it.
 Release sprint to fall or release movement input to slide slowly.
 Sneak to reduce the slide fall even more.

 You can jump from a wall to another by adjusting horizontal view angle.
 The position you jump from will adjust the hight of the wall jump.

wom:time_travel.name: Time travel
wom:time_travel.tooltip:
Register your position and health on cast.
After 5sec you'll be teleported back to your previus position and half of all damage taken within this time is healed.

Cast again to teleport early or sneak to cancel.

wom:true_berserk.name: True Wrath
wom:true_berserk.tooltip:
"May the god fear you..."

Torment wrath makes the skill gauge unreadable.

wom:unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
wom:unbreakable.tooltip:
Give you 3 charge of protection that grant you resistance and stun immunity uppon taking damage.
Lose a charge when taking damage.

wom:vampirize.name: Essence Extortion
wom:vampirize.tooltip: You heal yourself by 20% of the damage you deal.

wom:vengeful_parry.name: Vengeful parry
wom:vengeful_parry.tooltip:
Put you in a guarding stance for 2sec.
You will hold your position during that time blocking all attack at no stamina cost.
After that you'll be able to send back all the damage in your next attack.
Refresh damage on recast.
1sec cooldown.

wom:voodoo_magic.name: Voodoo magic
wom:voodoo_magic.tooltip:
Loosing Health increase Stamina by half,
Loosing Stamina increase Health by half.

Sneak to transfer health into stamina at double rate.

Disable stamina auto recovery.

mdvlcraft:wukong_dodge.name: Wukong Dodge
mdvlcraft:wukong_dodge.tooltip: Sun Wukong's dodge: a quick leap in the direction you are moving. Evades all incoming attacks.
